name: cinematic-narrative
description: 滚动式电影化分镜叙事工具
tagline: Scroll the Story, Direct the Scene.
interaction: As users scroll, the viewport becomes a cinematic canvas where each scene transitions with film-grade motion—zooms, fades, and parallax shifts triggered by scroll velocity and direction. Users can pause mid-scroll to explore layered details within each
while a timeline scrubber allows non-linear navigation through the narrative arc.
